inspiration.observed_pattern: A grouped MySQL report uses GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ...) with aggregate-local ordering and a custom separator, alongside HAVING-based group qualification.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a collection-label snapshot. Active item rows are grouped by collection, distinct labels are concatenated in descending order with a pipe separator, groups with at least two active rows are persisted through INSERT ... SELECT, and duplicate labels plus NULL labels exercise aggregate filtering. The source schema, rows, and reporting domain are newly authored.

fixture_notes: Collection 501 has three active rows with a duplicate ALPHA label and persists BETA|ALPHA; collection 502 has one active row and is excluded; collection 503 has two active rows including one NULL label and persists DELTA.
determinism_notes: Collection IDs, active flags, labels, aggregate ordering, separator, HAVING threshold, and final ordering are fixed. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE collection_items (item_id INT PRIMARY KEY, collection_id INT NOT NULL, item_label VARCHAR(32) NULL, active TINYINT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE collection_label_snapshots (collection_id INT PRIMARY KEY, active_item_count INT NOT NULL, distinct_labels VARCHAR(255) NULL)

steps.sql: INSERT INTO collection_label_snapshots (collection_id, active_item_count, distinct_labels) SELECT collection_id, COUNT(*), GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT item_label ORDER BY item_label DESC SEPARATOR '|') FROM collection_items WHERE active = 1 GROUP BY collection_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY collection_id

checks.sql: SELECT collection_id, active_item_count, distinct_labels FROM collection_label_snapshots ORDER BY collection_id

SELECT collection_id, COUNT(*) AS active_item_count, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT item_label ORDER BY item_label DESC SEPARATOR '|') AS distinct_labels FROM collection_items WHERE active = 1 GROUP BY collection_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY collection_id
